title: UNI faculty and staff members receive Regents Awards for Excellence
summary_en: Six University of Northern Iowa faculty and staff members were recognized with Regents Awards for Faculty and Staff Excellence at the Iowa Board of Regents meeting on UNI’s campus.
title_cn: UNI faculty and staff members receive Regents Awards for Excellence

title: TheatreUNI presents “A Midsummer Night’s Dream” by William Shakespeare, adapted and directed by Kendra Kahl
summary_en: For its first production of the 2026-27 season, themed “Wonderings and Wanderings,” TheatreUNI will present a high‑energy, Jazz Age, 90-minute production of William Shakespeare's romantic comedy “A Midsummer Night’s Dream."
title_cn: TheatreUNI presents “A Midsummer Night’s Dream” by William Shakespeare, adapted and directed by Kendra Kahl
